$comment: Budgets for the tx402 core import path. Authority: ADR-008.
ownCodeGzipBytes is RELEASE-BLOCKING and does not move. It measures only the code tx402
itself emits, treating @x402/core, zod, and every chain adapter as external. 25 KiB = 25600.
totalCorePathGzipBytes is a tracking ceiling, re-baselined only by an ADR-008 amendment that
records the measurement and the milestone. M1 froze 24 KiB, M2 amended to 28 KiB, and the M3
amendment sets 30 KiB from a measured 28.39 KiB core. The M5 amendment sets 32 KiB from a
measured 30.55 KiB core (route planner + health index).
The M5 note said this was frozen for good at M8. The S29 amendment moves it once more, to
32.25 KiB, and says plainly why: a HIGH-severity correctness fix measured 51 bytes over a
ceiling that had been sitting at exactly 32768 with zero headroom. Holding the number would
have meant either degrading the fix's diagnostics or deleting unrelated core code to buy
bytes, and the second of those is how collateral defects get introduced. The blocking gate
above did not move and is not affected: it measures tx402's own code and has ~7.7 KiB spare.
This ceiling includes @x402/core and zod, which tx402 does not control.
The 0.2.0 S2 amendment moves it to 34 KiB. SpendStore contract v2 (ReservationRef, the
exposed state and counters, MemorySpendStore v2's admin plane, the ReserveSpendResult
unwrap in the client) lands on the core path; own code measured 18,866 B (18.42 KiB, ~7 KiB
under the unchanged blocking gate) and the total measured 33,916 B (33.12 KiB). The 0.2.0
policy has S2-S6 each re-baseline as they add core code (checkSpendStore ships off-path via
the tx402/spend-store-contract subpath export, like the chain adapters).
The S6 amendment moves it to 35.5 KiB. Recipient pinning behaviour (SPEC §6 — the reserve
step-3 assert/claim in ledger.ts, the recipientPolicy config + advisory pre-filter in
policy.ts, the recipient plumbing + recipient.pinned/rejected emits in client.ts) lands on
the core path; own code measured 20,503 B (20.02 KiB, ~5 KiB under the unchanged blocking
gate) and the total measured 35,545 B (34.71 KiB), over the S2 34 KiB ceiling by 729 B.
Chain adapters (tx402/evm, tx402/solana) are measured and reported separately and are
excluded from both figures, consistent with the SPEC §12.3 carve-out. That exclusion covers
the lazy import() targets in src/core/chain.ts, which a real bundler code-splits.
